description: Deterministic rule-based Loss Risk Index (LRI) model. No ML, no randomness. All components yield bounded scores (0-100) and combine via weighted sum.

claims_history.notes: Claims risk increases with frequency and paid+reserved severity over a 36-month lookback.

telematics_behavior.notes: Telematics risk computed from event rates per 100 miles plus night-driving percentage. Period is typically last 30 days.

iot_asset_health.notes: IoT health risk increases when health_score is low and anomaly_count is high. Computed from most recent device metrics.

climate_hazard.notes: Climate hazard uses hazard_index (0-100) for the policy's region and relevant peril. Defaults to mid-risk if missing.

policy_exposure.notes: Policy exposure reflects asset value and coverage profile. Designed to be low-weight and stable.

rules.name: High risk coaching
rules.description: If overall risk is HIGH and telematics speeding is elevated, recommend driver coaching.

action.rationale: High overall risk and elevated telematics behavior risk; recommend driver coaching program.

rules.name: Asset inspection
rules.description: If IoT asset health risk is high, recommend inspection and maintenance.

action.rationale: IoT asset signals indicate elevated failure risk; recommend inspection/maintenance within 14 days.

rules.name: Climate mitigation checklist
rules.description: If climate hazard is high, provide region-specific mitigation checklist.

action.rationale: High climate hazard index in policy region; provide mitigation checklist to reduce loss probability.

rules.name: Claims review
rules.description: If claims history risk is high, recommend underwriting/claims review for targeted interventions.

action.rationale: Claims frequency/severity indicates elevated recurring loss exposure; initiate review for preventive recommendations.
